inventory.polarity: CAN WEAKEN. >1 enables candidate routes; measured +3 caught crews (max-latest-depart chooses long drives across a moving front). Prior hunt #2. REJECTED as built.

inventory.intercept: corridor (spread.tiered_eroded_p10; simui._eroded_p10 / _plan_eroded_rasters). Always euclidean discs. Radii FAST=550 / SH=200 / SLOW=150 vs uniform 500.

inventory.polarity: RELAXES grass/GS windows (45 -> 5-20 min) so a recently-burned grass cell becomes a legal transit route sooner. Tightens timber (45 -> 60-90). Mixed; grass direction is a law-weakening. CANDIDATE FOURTH.

inventory.intercept: alert ladder stage thresholds (P10 instead of P50 when cured-grass+wind detector fires)

inventory.intercept: ladder + dispatch threat ETAs for developed-cell homes (spread.eta_at adjacency fallback)

inventory.intercept: spread head ROS floor (spread._pack_params); live watcher arms via --grass-floor
inventory.polarity: Makes fire FASTER (coverage-conservative, area-inflating). Does not relax a safety law; it overrides extinction (A3 science defect).

inventory.intercept: corridor T* + travel along road polylines (dispatch.py). Road legs then use route_margin_roads_min=30 vs chord route_margin_min=56.
inventory.polarity: Honesty of geometry (chord-vs-road was the overrun tail). NUMERICALLY the road-leg margin drops 56->30 min. Documented as removing double-counted travel error, not as a law relaxation. Score as mixed, not a silent carve-out.

inventory.intercept: coating deferral (homes). Crew SEM-10 still governs idle/preposition.
inventory.polarity: Does not relax crew-safety. Hold releases if a probe cannot cover every coat-now home.

inventory.intercept: fatigue rest. Resting crews stay under SEM-10.
inventory.polarity: Cannot weaken a safety law; reduces dispatchable fleet.
Shorter gel life => earlier re-coat demand. Tightens home protection, not crew law. Not corridor/egress/audit.
